_comments.cookies_permission: CSO-005: The 'cookies' permission is required by @clerk/chrome-extension@3.x (installed: 3.1.21). When createClerkClient() is called with syncHost set (background/service-worker.src.js:127, syncHost=DEFAULT_API_BASE_URL), Clerk's validateManifest() calls validateManifestPermission(manifest,'cookies') and throws if absent. Clerk uses browser.cookies.get() and browser.cookies.onChanged to sync the __client JWT from the syncHost web-app cookie into extension storage. Removing 'cookies' will break background auth. See: chunk-IAAUBX2J.js line 398 (validateManifest), line 309 (getClientCookie).
